profiles.name: Huang Tiong Sii
profiles.position: Deputy Minister of Plantation and Commodities
profiles.description: Huang Tiong Sii represents Sarikei, Sarawak, in the Dewan Rakyat. Current role: Deputy Minister of Plantation and Commodities. Affiliated with SUPP.

milestones.title: Deliver the Bina Komuniti Tanjung Manis skills programme
milestones.description: Yusuf, also CIDB chair, launched the joint community programme with ABM construction-skills activities, including decorative painting and roof-truss installation.
milestones.progress_note: Achieved covers delivery of the reported programme session. CIDB, ABM, Puspanita and local partners shared responsibility. Participant certification, sustained employment, income gains and completed repair works were not established.

milestones.title: Present MRP assistance to 19 Sarikei organisations
milestones.description: Huang presented grant cheques to schools, associations and community organisations at the 19 August Sarikei constituency ceremony.
milestones.progress_note: The 20 August report describes the previous day’s ceremony. Achieved covers the presentation only; the article does not give a total amount or prove completed recipient projects or later spending.

methodology: Commitments, documented activities and limited delivery reports are distinct. Evidence-only records have no invented earlier promise. Achieved covers the described handover, programme session or launch only. Shared agency responsibility, historical dates, count units, source limitations and missing follow-up evidence are explicit. No claim of exhaustive research is made.
